form.label: VPN daemon logs - Overview
form.description: Fixture-backed overview for OpenVPN peer, certificate, session/virtual-IP/pool assignment, authentication-failure, and strongSwan _updown tunnel rows. Panels use fields proven by synthetic-equivalent fixtures and Splunk props; this dashboard is not replay/read-back validation.

search.query: index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | stats count
index=netauth sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" host=$host_tok$ action="auth_failed" result="failure" | stats count

index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | timechart count by sourcetype

index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | stats count by sourcetype action result signature signature_id | sort -count

panel.title: Top VPN peers and source endpoints

search.query: index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | stats count values(action) as actions values(result) as results values(src_ip) as src_ips values(src_port) as src_ports values(tunnel_ip) as tunnel_ips values(pool_ipv4) as pool_ipv4s values(pool_ipv6) as pool_ipv6s values(peer_ip) as peer_ips values(local_ip) as local_ips values(tunnel_network) as tunnel_networks by user client_context peer_id sourcetype | sort -count

panel.title: OpenVPN session, virtual IP, and failure review

search.query: index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product client_context user src src_ip src_port tunnel_ip pool_ipv4 pool_ipv6 action result reason signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product client_context cert_depth certificate_subject action result signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown" host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product peer_id user vendor_raw_action action result peer_ip local_ip tunnel_network src dest signature signature_id marker _raw | sort -_time | head 100

index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | stats count dc(marker) as fixture_markers values(vendor) as vendors values(product) as products min(_time) as first_seen max(_time) as last_seen by index sourcetype source host | convert ctime(first_seen) ctime(last_seen) | sort -count

search.query: index=netauth (sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:peer" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:verify" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:session" OR sourcetype="vpn:openvpn:auth" OR sourcetype="vpn:strongswan:updown") host=$host_tok$ | table _time host sourcetype source vendor product action result signature signature_id client_context peer_id src_ip src_port tunnel_ip pool_ipv4 pool_ipv6 peer_ip local_ip tunnel_network reason certificate_subject marker _raw | sort -_time | head 50
